scope: Datasets and evidence sources discussed in PROJECT_HANDOFF.md; downloaded inputs and caches stay under data/.

sources.role: Current UK-tagged catalogue; barcode, raw ingredients, quantities, images, revision references
sources.limitations: Not historical retail prices or a complete revision archive. Database edits are not market dates. Replacement links require evidence.

sources.role: Dated prices across five retailers, January-April 2024
sources.limitations: Only four calendar months. No barcodes/ingredients. Lowest available prices can include loyalty discounts.

sources.role: Supplementary barcode/date/store/proof-linked prices, explicit GB filter
sources.limitations: Sparse histories. Current enriched product mass is not dated historical pack proof.
Does not fulfil weekly input requirement; never interpolated to weekly observations.

sources.role: London, New York and ICCO cocoa prices
sources.limitations: Futures-derived definitions and roll conventions retained; publication/vintage timing and reuse review remain explicit.

sources.role: World cereal and oilseed quotes plus detailed EU cereal notifications
sources.limitations: Oilseeds are not crude edible oils. Detailed EU cereal series begin after retail-panel window. Publication/vintage timing not established.

sources.role: Original GBP per EUR and USD per EUR reference rates
sources.limitations: Normal release schedule alone does not establish each row's original publication or vintage.

sources.role: Reported change registry and reviewed Quality Street barcode membership
sources.limitations: Selected positives, exact transaction/transition dates unknown; not monthly training labels. The separate snack-cases registry now supplies the everyday-snack demo.

sources.role: Quality Street, Doritos, Digestives, Snickers, Oreo Bites, M&M's Chocolate and Maltesers, with per-case source links and price bases
sources.limitations: Five reported shelf-price pairs, one RRP comparison and one size-only case. Exact transition dates remain unknown; only Quality Street has reviewed old/new barcodes. One source access note is retained separately from article captures. These selected cases are not monthly training labels.

sources.reason: Long history of basket-item microdata does not directly provide branded barcode or ingredient histories. A separate category-level experiment could use it later.
Branded longitudinal data requires access arrangements; not a runnable public dependency.
212-item daily basket since 2026-09-24. As of 2026-11-08 it has only one complete calendar month; useful future barcode/size/loyalty evidence, but does not extend the 2024 modelling panel.
Bulk API/download and permission to ingest a full dataset have not been established.

missing_inputs: Genuine weekly crude edible-oil and relevant dairy feeds
Dated historical pack/ingredient observations and reviewed cross-barcode replacements
Commodity publication/vintage timing suitable for historical cutoffs
